data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (31 December 2018 comparative) was $617.778m. Analysis of the gross claims development table indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $36.228m (5.9% of opening gross claims), driven primarily by adverse development on the 2017 underwriting year. This prior year strengthening was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (see notes).
raw_causal_phrases: higher frequency or severity of claims experience (claims risk), or inadequate or insufficient loss reserving (reserving risk).

Claims incurred represent the cost of claims and settlement expenses paid during the financial year, together with the movement in provisions for outstanding claims and claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was not stated as a single gross movement in the narrative. The prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) on page 24. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding) on page 15. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). The field names use the suffix '_gbp_m' per template but amounts are in USD millions. No explicit textual sentence quantifying gross prior-year movement was found.
